title: Embed-rerank: instrument quality gate with customer prompt-sets and A/B hooks
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a deployable instrumentation and experiment framework that ties offline NDCG/MRR evals on curated customer prompt-sets to live A/B experiments for the embeddings+rerank endpoint. This ticket covers dataset curation, offline eval integration, telemetry hooks, and the minimal runtime changes to emit per-request rerank scoring metadata and timing information.

Background: We have multiple customers reporting small regressions after model swaps; current observability surfaces aggregate embedding latency and token-level metrics but not rerank quality. We need a repeatable pipeline to: 1) validate candidate model+reranker combos against customer prompt-sets offline (NDCG@5, MRR@10), 2) run canary A/Bs with per-cohort metrics surfaced in Console, and 3) ensure the reranking path maintains SLOs for p50/p95 latency under production load.

Scope:
- Curate 6 customer prompt-sets (anonymized) spanning search, recommendations, and Q&A.
- Add offboard evaluator job that computes NDCG@1/3/5 and MRR@10 for candidate variants and stores results in evals-db.
- Instrument rerank endpoint to emit: per-request chosen-ranker-id, candidate-scores (top-10), final-rank-order, compute-time-ms, and batch-size metadata.
- Hook experiment SDK so A/B groups (variant/control) tag telemetry with experiment_id and cohort.
- Create Console dashboard showing NDCG and MRR over time per-experiment and per-customer cohort, with latency breakdown and failure rates.

Out of scope for this ticket: automated model retraining, cohort-level automated rollbacks, and expanding prompt-sets beyond the initial 6 customers.
acceptance_criteria: Offline eval job ingests all 6 prompt-sets and produces NDCG@1/3/5 and MRR@10 scores for each model+reranker variant
Rerank endpoint emits the required telemetry fields (ranker_id, candidate_scores, final_order, compute_time_ms, batch_size) in structured logs and traces
Experiment SDK tags request telemetry with experiment_id and cohort and can be toggled via Console for canary A/Bs
Console dashboard shows per-experiment NDCG and MRR with ability to filter by customer cohort and time window
End-to-end A/B run completed internally with traffic split, and privacy-sanitized results recorded in experiments table
success_metrics: Baseline: NDCG@5 >= 0.68 for core search prompt-set during canary
MRR@10 uplift >= 2% vs control for at least 2 customer cohorts or no significant degradation
P95 rerank compute_time_ms < 120ms under steady-state load (1000 qps across dedicated pool)
Experiment telemetry latency overhead < 3ms p50 and < 10ms p95
End-to-end eval pipeline reproducibility: identical offline scores for repeated runs on the same snapshot
implementation_steps: 1. Acquire and sanitize 6 customer prompt-sets (PM to coordinate data access and legal approval)
2. Extend offline eval harness to accept nested candidates and compute NDCG/MRR with relevance labels; add export to evals-db
3. Add structured telemetry fields to rerank service (protobuf schema change + migration plan)
4. Instrument experiment SDK to add experiment_id/cohort headers and ensure propagation through async worker boundaries
5. Create Console dashboard panels and alert rules for NDGC/MRR regressions and latency breaches
6. Internal canary: run 5% traffic experiment for 48h, collect metrics, expand to 20% if no regressions
7. Post-mortem checklist: collect PR IDs, perf traces, memory/CPU profiles for any regressions
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sensitive customer content in prompt-sets could leak. Mitigation: PM and Legal sign-off; strip PII and store encrypted in evals-db with KMS keys.
Risk: Telemetry payload size increases causing higher latency. Mitigation: send summarized candidate_scores (top-10 only) and sample full payloads at 1% for debugging.
Risk: Protobuf change could break older clients. Mitigation: use additive fields and backward-compatible encoding; rollout via canary pools.
Risk: Offline vs online mismatch. Mitigation: correlate offline labels with online click/engagement signals in experiment results and log mismatches for manual review.
